scope: Learning assignment loading, empty programme guidance, methodist handoff and safe recovery
findings: A fresh tenant with no published programmes returns HTTP 200. Empty programmes alone did not reproduce the screenshot server failure; its production correlation ID was not traced.
Context reads, selection failures and assignment failures shared one error and a retry that only reloaded context.
Archive entries could be selected although assignment rejects archived organizations.
Completed operations with failed rows were reused and returned cached failures after data was repaired.
Pre-assignment group/access settings were lost on catalogue navigation; an older draft could override an explicit course choice.
Pending recovery could change the payload after server group updates or drop a null customerId on reload.
implemented: Separate context loading/error from successful empty catalogue and assignment outcomes; explicit disabled-action explanations and action-specific retry.
Methodist preparation/review/publication guidance, safe return from catalogue and explicit programme refresh.
Scoped, validated session drafts preserve selected people, programme, group and access policy.
Published-version selection and pause/unavailable guidance; explicit course links take priority over old drafts.
Unknown assignment results freeze the submitted payload and reuse the same operation; completed failed rows start a new attempt.
Archived organizations cannot be selected; existing archived context has a visible correction route.
Loading/submission locks protect selection and async organization changes.

browser.environment: Real isolated API and disposable PostgreSQL at local ports 4168/55468; Chromium desktop and 390px mobile viewport
cases: Fresh SUPER_ADMIN: load failure, retry and legitimate empty catalogue
Fresh DIRECTOR: load failure, retry and legitimate empty catalogue
Fresh OPERATOR: load failure, retry and legitimate empty catalogue
Methodist creates programme and submits review; director approves/publishes; operator assigns preserved mobile draft
Failed context refresh preserves selected people, programme, group and access settings
Accepted assignment with lost response repeats the same operation without duplicate enrollments
Archived organization excluded from picker; archived deep-link recovery
Known assignment rejection remains distinct from failed context refresh and succeeds after correction
Completed failed rows are retried with a new operation and the same selected set
Pending group assignment survives group rename/deadline change and page reload with identical submitted payload
browser.authoringBoundary: Synthetic lesson content populated through methodist authenticated API; create/review/approve/publish and assignment exercised through UI.
